service-scrape.label: Annotated metrics Service
service-scrape.description: Expose an existing workload’s metrics to the chart’s default Service discovery job.

fields.label: Service name
fields.description: Name of the Service that exposes metrics.

fields.label: Service namespace
fields.description: Namespace of the Pods this Service selects.

fields.label: Pod label key
fields.description: Label key used to select the metrics Pods.

fields.label: Pod label value
fields.description: Label value on the metrics Pods.

fields.label: Service port
fields.description: Port clients use to reach the Service.

fields.label: Target port
fields.description: Port the selected Pods actually listen on.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Protocol served by the metrics endpoint.

fields.label: Metrics path
fields.description: URL path where the target serves metrics.

scrape-job.label: Custom scrape job
scrape-job.description: Add a named static target to an existing standalone Prometheus Helm release.

fields.label: Job name
fields.description: Choose a name that is unique in the release’s scrape configuration.

fields.label: Scrape interval
fields.description: Time between requests to the target.

fields.label: Metrics path
fields.description: URL path where the target serves metrics.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Protocol served by the metrics endpoint.

fields.label: Target address
fields.description: Host and port reachable from Prometheus.

alert-rule.label: Alert rule
alert-rule.description: Evaluate a PromQL condition in an existing standalone Prometheus Helm release.

fields.label: Rule group
fields.description: Name of the group Prometheus evaluates together.

fields.label: Alert name
fields.description: Name shown when this alert is pending or firing.

fields.label: PromQL expression
fields.description: Condition Prometheus evaluates for the alert.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: How long the condition must hold before the alert fires.

fields.label: Severity
fields.description: Label to use for routing or display.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Short description to show when the alert fires.
